AboutPage.historyTitle: A vision born from deep conviction
AboutPage.historyP1: Created with the ambition to bring Moroccan consumers closer to the best European standards, AFAQ Health is not just a distributor — it is a bridge between scientific innovation and patient needs.
AboutPage.historyP2: We noticed a gap between natural health solutions available internationally and those accessible locally. Our mission became clear: identify exceptional, certified brands and establish them sustainably in the Moroccan and West African markets.
AboutPage.qualityPromise: Every product is a promise of quality
AboutPage.qualityP1: The ecosystem we have built rests on an unwavering commitment to public health. Every imported reference goes through a rigorous approval filter (AMMPS), ensuring that pharmacists deliver safe advice and patients consume effective products.
AboutPage.qualityP2: AFAQ Health is committed to supporting healthcare professionals in their daily practice, with training, detailed technical sheets, and constant support.
AboutPage.pillarsSubtitle: The foundations on which we build our distribution network. Excellence is not an act, but a habit carried by our team every day.
AboutPage.value1Desc: Every distributed product undergoes meticulous examination of its formulation and clinical efficacy.
AboutPage.value2Desc: We guarantee absolute respect for regulatory standards and Moroccan pharmaceutical standards.
AboutPage.value3Desc: From pharmacist training to patient counseling, we ensure a constant presence in the field.
AboutPage.scientificSubtitle: At the heart of our business lies an absolute requirement: science. Discover how we select and formulate exceptional products.
AboutPage.researchP1: Every dietary supplement we introduce to the Moroccan market is the result of a drastic selection process. Our scientific team evaluates partner laboratories on strict criteria: raw material quality, active ingredient bioavailability, and formulation stability.
AboutPage.researchP2: We don't just distribute products; we decode the science behind them. Whether essential vitamins or innovative plant complexes, we ensure that each dosage corresponds to real metabolic needs.
AboutPage.clinicalResearchDesc: Analysis of studies validating the efficacy of active ingredients.
AboutPage.extractPurityDesc: Control of the origin and traceability of raw materials.
AboutPage.bioavailabilityDesc: Choice of galenic forms offering the best absorption by the body.
AboutPage.toleranceDesc: Guaranteed absence of side effects thanks to optimized dosages.
AboutPage.safetyP1: In an increasingly complex health market, safety is non-negotiable. Before reaching your pharmacy shelves, our products go through exhaustive regulatory steps in accordance with European and Moroccan standards.
AboutPage.safetyP2: Obtaining the marketing visa from the Ministry of Health (AMMPS) is the minimum requirement for us. We go further by training our partner pharmacists in the pharmacological specifics of each product.
AboutPage.safetyQuote: "Innovation only makes sense when delivered with the guarantee of total safety."
